svg.text: A worked example - Japan to India
One person's actual path, described by what each step does rather than by whose logo is on it.
STEPS 1-5 · GETTING IT INTO THE ACCOUNT YOU INVEST FROM

a mandate does the work each month

An eNACH mandate pulls the agreed amount

Bought at the applicable NAV, held in a
folio or in demat - the platform decides.
The mandate every month, and a one-off
each purchase is a decision you make
Transferred from the account to the broker

One route that works, not a recommendation and not a comparison. Providers are deliberately unnamed: the mechanism is what transfers, and the brand is the part you would have to swap out anyway.
